home.faqDescription: Start with the equipment, the constraint, or the target. We will help you find a route that is practical, secure, and worth measuring.
home.faq1A: We review your equipment, volumes, locations, and priorities, then outline a collection and recovery route that fits your operation.
home.faq2Q: Can you work across multiple sites?
home.faq2A: Yes. We plan collections for offices, warehouses, facilities, and distributed sites with timing and handling shaped around your team.
home.faq3A: Data-aware handling is built into the route. We agree the required controls and document each accountable handoff.
home.faq4A: We work across IT equipment, electronic devices, components, and printing hardware. Share what you have and we will confirm the best route.
home.faq5Q: Do you provide official certificates and ESG impact reports?
home.faq5A: Yes. Every recovery cycle includes an official DR.WEEE Certificate of Safe Recycling and a verified ESG report detailing materials saved, carbon offsets, and regulatory compliance proof.
home.faq6Q: How long does the collection process take?
home.faq6A: Typically, scheduled corporate collections in Cairo and major industrial zones take 48 to 72 business hours from confirmation. Dedicated timelines are arranged for multi-site decommission projects.
home.faq7Q: Do you offer financial value or store credit for retired assets?
home.faq7A: Yes. Recoverable devices and high-yield components can be appraised for cash returns or credited into our circular store program for remanufactured office hardware and toner supplies.
home.faq8Q: How is data destruction verified and certified?
home.faq8A: We adhere strictly to international NIST 800-88 and DoD sanitization standards, providing serialised data-wiping logs and physical destruction certificates for storage media.

story.subtitle: How we work
story.title: From retired equipment to renewed value
story.narrativeBody: In 2018, Cairo faced a quiet crisis: thousands of tons of electronics disappeared into unmonitored scrap heaps, burnt for base metals or discarded in landfills, poisoning air and groundwater. DR.WEEE was founded to transform this hazard into an accountable industrial resource. After rigorous training with the United Nations University in Italy, our founders built Egypt's first licensed, fully auditable recovery facility. Instead of stopping at simple collection, we engineered sovereign shredding machinery, launched toner remanufacturing with Spear Ink, and built transparent compliance tracking. Today, DR.WEEE operates across 11+ international markets, turning retired tech into measurable value, certified materials, and verified ESG impact.

materials.card4Desc: Batteries, capacitor banks, and mercury backlights are safely extracted in isolated negative-pressure clean cells under certified WMRA guidelines.

balance.title: Total Circular Material Distribution

carbon.description: Recycling secondary metals consumes up to 95% less energy than mining and smelting virgin ores. Here is the verified planetary equivalent of our cumulative recovery operations.
carbon.card1Desc: Equivalent 10-year atmospheric carbon sequestration achieved by avoiding virgin smelting.
carbon.card2Desc: Megawatt-hours of industrial energy prevented from fossil fuel combustion in mining corridors.
carbon.card3Desc: Tons of bauxite, chalcopyrite, and gold ore left intact in Earth's natural crust.
carbon.card4Desc: Liters of toxic runoff prevented from polluting agricultural groundwater basins.

compliance.description: Every collection event produces serial-level documentation, ensuring airtight legal protection, corporate ESG alignment, and official state regulatory clearance.

compliance.p3Desc: Full statutory licensing from Egypt's Waste Management Regulatory Authority (WMRA) protecting corporate leadership against environmental liabilities.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Text: DR.WEEE Smart Green IT Solutions ("DR.WEEE," "we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect information when you visit our website, use our services, or contact us.
privacy.s2Text1: We may collect information you provide directly, including your name, email address, phone number, account details, service requests, and messages submitted through our forms.
privacy.s2Text2: We may also collect technical information such as your IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and approximate location through cookies, analytics, and similar technologies.
privacy.s3Text: We use information to provide and improve our services, respond to inquiries, process requests, maintain accounts, send service communications, protect our website, understand website usage, and comply with legal obligations.
privacy.s4Text: We may share information with service providers that help operate our website and business, including hosting, analytics, communications, payment, and Microsoft cloud services. We may also disclose information when required by law or necessary to protect our rights, users, or property. We do not sell personal information.
privacy.s5Text: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to remember preferences, support functionality, measure performance, and improve the user experience. You can control cookies through your browser settings, although some features may not work correctly when cookies are disabled.
privacy.s6Text: We retain information only as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, unless a longer period is required by law. We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards, but no online service can guarantee absolute security.
privacy.s7Text: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to certain uses of your personal information. To make a request, contact us using the details below. We may need to verify your identity before completing a request.
privacy.s8Text: Our website is not directed to children under the age required by applicable law. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
privacy.s9Text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated version will be posted on this page with a revised date.
privacy.s10Text: For privacy questions or requests, contact DR.WEEE at info@drweee.com or visit our Contact Us page.
